messages:
ana: Quick sync — we need to lock priority for the Optimize toolkit release that feeds into Q3 OKRs. Customers keep asking for batching/caching recommendations + a regression guard. Proposing a narrow v0 to ship in 8w. Thoughts?
chris: Narrow v0 sounds right. Engineering risk is mostly the runtime hooks and safe defaults. I suggest split into: 1) a recommender service (stateless) 2) an eval harness that runs nightly. That keeps serving path simple.
liam: Agree on split. For regression detection we should commit to a small prompt set (20 prompts) and two metrics: output-fluency drop and latency delta. Need to define thresholds (e.g. >3% perf regression or >5% quality drop triggers rollback).
sophia: From DevEx: shipping SDK hooks + a single config API for `cache_policy` is enough for v0. Docs + example prompts can be shipped as a follow-up patch. We can provide a quickstart with one-liner: `ri.optimize.configure({cache_policy:'prefix_5s'})`
morgan: Customer ask: want deterministic, explainable recs for chat apps — e.g., when to cache prefix vs full conversation. If v0 can't cover everything, call out "supported patterns" explicitly in launch.
chris: Proposal for launch criteria (candidate):
- Recs engine: returns recommendations for 90th pct of sampled workloads
- Eval harness: daily regression job with alerting to #incidents if thresholds breach
- SDK + CLI: basic enable/disable and example integration
- Docs: patterns + safe defaults
liam: Implementation details: we need instrumentation for seq len histograms, KV cache hit/miss, and token cost delta. I'll dump a small log snippet we can parse:
```
[req_id:abc] seq_len=128, cached_prefix=64, kv_hits=12, kv_misses=2, latency_ms=32
```
sophia: UX note — keep CLI output concise, e.g. `ri-optimize analyze --app APP_ID` prints top 3 recs. PMs want :thumbsup: on that.
nana (ana typo correction): ana: ha — small typo, meant me :)
morgan: Should we include a gating step in rollout: canary to 5% traffic + manual review of flagged regressions before full rollout? Customers prefer manual for first few weeks.
chris: Canary + automatic rollback policy seems safe. We'll add an opt-in for auto-rollbacks.
liam: On the eval side, need storage for prompt results (retention 90d). That will feed regressions/quality dashboards.
sophia: I can draft the SDK surface and a one-page Quickstart for tomorrow. If we accept the candidate launch criteria, I'll scope the docs deliverable.
nana (ana): OK — decision checklist: 1) accept split architecture 2) adopt candidate launch criteria 3) ship v0 with 20 prompt set + basic SDK + canary rollout. If no objections by EOD, we'll lock for planning. :thinking_face:
deploy-bot: scheduled: planning-doc created -> https://r-internal/optimize/v0/planning (auto)
chris: +1 from eng. keeping engineering estimate at 6-8w.
liam: +1 on reg checks. I'll start curating prompts with research.
morgan: +1 from CS, will gather 3 customer examples to validate v0 patterns.
sophia: +1. I'll own Quickstart and CLI UX.
nana (ana): Great — locking unless someone objects. Sending to roadmap after EOD. :rocket:
